name: Yancy Academy
excerpt: Yancy Academy is a private school for troubled kids in upstate New York.
notes: Yancy Academy is a private school located in upstate New York, known for accepting troubled kids. Percy Jackson is a student here, and the school has a reputation for having strict rules and a challenging environment for its students.
